request_summary.last_message: {"content":"Organisation: globex-002. Admin role: it_admin.\n\nRequest: Give me the three most urgent issues in our fleet right now.","role":"user"}

content.text: {"intent":"insight","restated_question":"Identify the three highest-priority problems across the globex-002 fleet based on current telemetry. Urgency is ranked by detector severity, then by the number of devices affected. Problems include low disk, disk-fill trends, RAM pressure, batteries near end-of-life, compliance drift, risky software, telemetry gaps and failing compliance checks.","assumptions":["'Urgent' means the highest severity reported by the deterministic detectors. Ties are broken by how many devices are affected and by whether the problem is getting worse over the 30-day window.","'Right now' means the latest snapshot, plus any trend findings that point to imminent problems.","An issue can be a fleet-wide pattern (for example, a compliance check failing on many devices) or a critical problem on a single device.","The admin wants a summary, not remediation actions."],"steps":[{"tool":"run_insights","purpose":"Run all detectors (disk_low, disk_trend, ram_pressure, battery_eol, compliance_drift, risky_software, telemetry_gap) to get severity-ranked findings and affected device counts."},{"tool":"compliance_overview","purpose":"Get current pass/fail counts per compliance check and how the failing count changed, so widespread or worsening compliance failures can be weighed against the detector findings."}],"may_propose_actions":false,"out_of_scope_reason":""}
